title: Finite local constancy of the coefficient dual
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $\Lambda$ a commutative noetherian ring, and $F$ a finite locally constant sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-constructible-finite-locally-constant]. The internal Hom $\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(F,\Lambda_X)$ is finite locally constant.

source.place: IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf.ihom_unit docstring, local finite presentation and dual finite generation

proof.text: Use the local constancy theorem for the coefficient dual.

Fix a geometric point s. Finite stalks of F give Module.Finite Λ F_s via ModuleCat.isFinitelyGenerated_iff. Mathlib isNoetherian_linearMap and IsNoetherian.finite give finite generation of Hom_Λ(F_s,Λ), since Λ is noetherian. The stalk comparison identifies this module with the stalk of the sheaf dual; transport finite generation along the inverse isomorphism using ConcreteCategory.IsFinitelyGenerated.of_iso.
Supply the local constancy and finite-stalk fields of IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf.
